parameters.query:
=SELECT ni.title AS titel, ni.published_at, ni.created_at, v.ticker_json AS betroffene_ticker_json,
       v.wirkungsebene, v.direction AS wirkungsrichtung, v.effect_level AS wirkung_staerke,
       v.ticker_begruendung, v.wirkungs_begruendung
FROM trading.v_news_latest_assessment v
JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = v.news_id
WHERE v.relevance = TRUE AND v.effect_level = 'hoch'
  AND (ni.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
SELECT * FROM trading.recommendations ORDER BY id;

parameters.query: SELECT config_key, value_bool, value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('DRY_RUN','REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION','TREND_KONFLIKT_SCHWELLE','MODEL_PORTFOLIO_VALUE','MAX_RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT','MIN_REWARD_RISK_RATIO','MAX_POSITION_VALUE_PCT','DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS','DEFAULT_FEES_BPS','MAX_DATA_AGE_MINUTES');

SELECT ticker, snapshot_date, aktueller_kurs, rsi, richtung, handels_status, atr_14_numeric, atr_stop_numeric, atr_target_numeric, data_quality_status, breakout_history_ausreichend, dominant_strategy, session_status FROM trading.technical_signals_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 5 ORDER BY ticker, snapshot_date;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS anzahl FROM trading.market_context_history WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT ticker, business_date, strategy, direction, raw_score, regime_fit, data_quality_score, entry_zone_low, entry_zone_high, stop_price, target_price, expected_horizon_days, time_stop_at, evidence_json, blockers_json, rule_version FROM trading.strategy_signals WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE AND valid_to IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM trading.market_regime WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT ticker, snapshot_date, eigenkapitalrendite_numeric, gewinnmarge_numeric, verschuldungsgrad_numeric, kursziel_numeric, kgv_numeric, kbv_numeric FROM trading.fundamentals_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 180 AND valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY ticker, snapshot_date;
SELECT ticker, CASE WHEN exchange = 'XETRA' THEN 'Europa' WHEN exchange IN ('NASDAQ','NYSE') THEN 'USA' ELSE 'global' END AS region FROM trading.stock_instruments;
